visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with bleached hair and white-rimmed glasses stands in a room, wearing a grey long-sleeved shirt and grey cargo pants. He holds a large cardboard box featuring Mickey Mouse and Marvel character illustrations against a backdrop of red and white vertical stripes. (2) The scene cuts to the man leaning over the boxes, gesturing excitedly toward the camera while presenting the 'Beast Kingdom' logo. (3) He lifts and drops a red Marvel-branded hard suitcase onto a table covered with a green and white checkered cloth, demonstrating its portability. (4) The man opens the suitcase to reveal a full set of Mahjong tiles, rulers, and accessories, carefully picking up a set of keys used to lock the case. (5) Close-up shots show Mahjong tiles with intricate designs based on Marvel characters like Iron Man, Scarlet Witch, and Captain America, as the man points to specific details. (6) The man interacts with the tiles by stacking them into a tower and then knocking them down in a playful manner. (7) Finally, the man poses with his arms crossed over his chest, mimicking a superhero stance while looking directly into the lens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal male vocal delivery with bright spectral characteristics begins immediately, introducing the product. Background music is a high-tempo electronic pop track with a heavy 4/4 synthetic kick drum and bright sawtooth synth textures. Ambient noise is negligible. (2) A dull, percussive impact sound occurs as a heavy object hits the table. The speaker's volume swells in intensity. Short digital 'pop' sound effects are inserted during quick visual transitions to emphasize visual beats. (3) Frequent high-frequency clacking and clicking sounds from mahjong tiles being handled create a busy acoustic texture. The speaker maintains a fast speech rate with rising intonation patterns to convey excitement. (4) Digital 'ding' and 'sparkle' sound effects accompany the revelation of character designs on tiles. The BGM remains consistent in the background with a steady rhythmic pulse, providing a energetic foundation for the narration. (5) Final phase features a loud vocal exclamation as the speaker poses. The music maintains its energy until a sharp hard cut silence at the very end of the recording.
